# awscc_personalize_metric_attribution (Resource)

Creates a metric attribution for reporting on recommendation impact in Amazon Personalize.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_group_arn` (String) The ARN of the destination dataset group.
- `metrics` (Attributes List) A list of metric attributes for the metric attribution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `metrics_output_config` (Attributes) The output configuration details for the metric attribution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_output_config))
- `name` (String) The name of the metric attribution.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `metric_attribution_arn` (String) The ARN of the metric attribution.
- `status` (String) The status of the metric attribution.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Required:

- `event_type` (String) The metric's event type.
- `expression` (String) The attribute's expression.
- `metric_name` (String) The metric's name.


<a id="nestedatt--metrics_output_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_output_config`

Required:

- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role for the metric attribution.

Optional:

- `s3_data_destination` (Attributes) The configuration details of an Amazon S3 output bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_output_config--s3_data_destination))

<a id="nestedatt--metrics_output_config--s3_data_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_output_config.s3_data_destination`

Optional:

- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the KMS key.
- `path` (String) The file path of the Amazon S3 bucket.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_metric_attribution.example
  identity = {
    metric_attribution_arn = "metric_attribution_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `metric_attribution_arn` (String) The ARN of the metric attribution

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_metric_attribution.example
  id = "metric_attribution_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
